name: GlobalOps Calendar — API on RapidAPI
description:
Plan working days across countries in one call: GlobalOps Calendar computes real workdays from the public-holiday set for a batch of country windows and attaches World Bank context indicators — always with their data year — so global scheduling and market planning stop guessing.

What you get:
- Workday counts per country and window, computed only from public holidays (observance and school days never counted as days off)
- The holiday list behind every count, so results are auditable
- Economic context indicators with the year attached to every value — no undated 'current' figures
- Honest coverage: countries outside the dataset return a clean NOT_COVERED instead of a guess; China's set covers anchor public-holiday dates without adjusted weekends or merged leave

Key endpoints:
- POST /plan/batch — plan multiple country windows in one call
- POST /plan/single — plan one country window
- GET /health — service status

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
